# Launch Screen Assets

The images in this folder are the Relay mark: an ink rounded square, two white strokes, and a cobalt dot. They are what iOS shows in the center of the white launch screen.

`LaunchImage.png` is 120×120. `LaunchImage@2x.png` is 240×240. `LaunchImage@3x.png` is 360×360.

To use a different mark, replace those three files, or open the project with `open ios/Runner.xcworkspace`, select `Runner/Assets.xcassets` in the Project Navigator, and drop the new images onto `LaunchImage`.
